== Description ==

At a table at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025: [[Ken Cross]] (front left, grey and black Columbia fleece), [[Jonny Chu]] (back left, black hoodie and glasses), and [[Paul Coggins]] (front right, plaid shirt), with a fourth player in a black zip hoodie and glasses (back right, unlabeled).
